lines.zh: 我的鳍足撑起身子，冰面下沉一寸。
lines.en: My flippers lift my body and the ice sinks an inch.

lines.zh: 我走路像海象，但尾巴后面拖着剑。
lines.en: I walk like a walrus with swords dragging behind me.

lines.zh: 膜翼收在身侧，走路时蹭着雪。
lines.en: My membrane wings fold at my sides and brush the snow.

lines.zh: 每一步都碾碎一层薄冰。
lines.en: Every step grinds a layer of thin ice to pieces.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，速度对我没有意义。
lines.en: I walk slowly; speed means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 尾尖扫过海面，水就不结冰了。
lines.en: My tail tip sweeps the sea, and the water stops freezing.

lines.zh: 从海冰走上岸，我只用了四步。
lines.en: I go from sea ice to shore in four strides.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙先到，身体后到。
lines.en: My tusks arrive before the rest of me.

lines.zh: 冰铠在肩上响，像铁片互相磨。
lines.en: The ice armor on my shoulders rasps like grinding plates.

lines.zh: 没有人陪我走，这条路我走过千次。
lines.en: No one walks with me; I have crossed this path a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我把雪踩成一条河床。
lines.en: I trample the snow into the bed of a river.

lines.zh: 风推我的膜翼，我懒得张开。
lines.en: Wind pushes my wings; I cannot be bothered to open them.

lines.zh: 我浮在冰水里，只露出鼻孔。
lines.en: I float in the ice water with only my nostrils out.

lines.zh: 一千年的名字压在我脊椎上。
lines.en: A thousand years of names weigh on my spine.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，冰铠还在慢慢长。
lines.en: I close my eyes and the ice armor keeps growing.

lines.zh: 远处的冰山塌了，我没有动。
lines.en: A distant iceberg collapses; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸孔喷出一道白雾。
lines.en: My blowhole vents a column of white mist.

lines.zh: 独居不是选择，是体重决定的。
lines.en: Solitude is not a choice; my weight decides it.

lines.zh: 海面结冰的声音像有人在磨牙。
lines.en: The sea freezing sounds like someone grinding teeth.

lines.zh: 我把獠牙搁在冰上，凉得刚好。
lines.en: I rest my tusks on the ice; the cold is just right.

lines.zh: 有鲸在下面唱歌，我听了一半。
lines.en: A whale sings below and I listen to half of it.

lines.zh: 我的脂肪层存着上次战斗的热。
lines.en: My fat layer stores the heat of my last battle.

lines.zh: 冰从我背脊爬上来，又退下去。
lines.en: Ice climbs my spine and then retreats.

lines.zh: 我动一下，整片浮冰都晃。
lines.en: I shift once and the whole floe rocks.

lines.zh: 我在数浮冰，数到六就停了。
lines.en: I count the ice floes and stop at six.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我像一座会呼吸的岛。
lines.en: At rest I am an island that breathes.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我的呼吸能冻住你。
lines.en: You stand too close; my breath can freeze you.

lines.zh: 小东西，你的心跳快得像雨点。
lines.en: Little thing, your heartbeat is as fast as rain.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，獠牙几乎碰到你。
lines.en: I lower my head, tusks almost touching you.

lines.zh: 别的小东西都跑了，你留下来了。
lines.en: Other little things run; you have stayed.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看见了火，这里不该有火。
lines.en: I see fire in your eyes; there should be no fire here.

lines.zh: 你手里的铁，我闻得出冷热。
lines.en: I can smell the hot and cold of the iron in your hand.

lines.zh: 别把我的鳍足当成石头踩。
lines.en: Do not mistake my flipper for a stepping stone.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，久到你开始发抖。
lines.en: I look at you so long that you begin to shiver.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在我面前结成白霜。
lines.en: Your breath freezes into white frost before me.

lines.zh: 我会记住你的味道，海会忘记。
lines.en: I will remember your scent; the sea will forget.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛比冰面干净。
lines.en: Your eyes are clearer than the ice sheet.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，这个动作已经算友好。
lines.en: I turn my head; for me that counts as kindness.

lines.zh: 这一下，连冰铠都裂了。
lines.en: That blow cracked even the ice armor.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没有流过血。
lines.en: I have not bled in a very long time.

lines.zh: 你把我的脂肪层划开了。
lines.en: You have cut open my fat layer.

lines.zh: 疼是旧的，我倒有点怀念。
lines.en: Pain is an old thing; I almost missed it.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸停了一瞬，海也停了。
lines.en: My breath stops for a moment, and the sea stops too.

lines.zh: 这一击值得记住，我会记住。
lines.en: This blow is worth remembering, and I will.

lines.zh: 冰铠在补，但比平常慢。
lines.en: The ice armor is mending, slower than usual.

lines.zh: 你们终于找到能伤我的东西了。
lines.en: You finally found something that can hurt me.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，只这一步。
lines.en: I retreat one step, only one.

lines.zh: 血滴在冰上，烧出一个小洞。
lines.en: A drop of blood burns a small hole in the ice.

lines.zh: 那团火光，我本该躲开的。
lines.en: That patch of firelight is something I should avoid.

lines.zh: 热的东西靠近，我的冰铠就痒。
lines.en: When heat comes near, my ice armor itches.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我却往前挪了一步。
lines.en: You raise a torch, and I shift one step forward.

lines.zh: 我很久没有感觉过暖了。
lines.en: I have not felt warmth in a very long time.

lines.zh: 温泉在冒气，我把鼻子伸过去。
lines.en: The hot spring steams and I push my nose toward it.

lines.zh: 这点热度伤不了我，只让我困。
lines.en: This little heat cannot hurt me; it only makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我想把整座火山含在嘴里。
lines.en: I want to hold a whole volcano in my mouth.

lines.zh: 靠近点，让我看看你手里的光。
lines.en: Come closer and let me see the light in your hand.

lines.zh: 冷了一千年，一点暖就够我失态。
lines.en: After a thousand cold years, a little warmth undoes me.

lines.zh: 我的鳍足已经朝你那边转了。
lines.en: My flippers have already turned toward you.

lines.zh: 你撞在我冰铠上，像撞上悬崖。
lines.en: You strike my ice armor as if striking a cliff.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，海面裂了三道。
lines.en: I step back and the sea surface cracks in three lines.

lines.zh: 让开，我的尾巴不看路。
lines.en: Move aside; my tail does not watch the road.

lines.zh: 你被弹开不是我推的，是重量。
lines.en: You bounce off not because I push, but because of weight.

lines.zh: 我的鳍足压过你的脚印。
lines.en: My flipper presses over your footprints.

lines.zh: 我转身慢，你最好先让开。
lines.en: I turn slowly; you had better step aside first.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你听见的是冰碎。
lines.en: When we collide, what you hear is ice breaking.

lines.zh: 我尽量轻了，还是把你推开了。
lines.en: I tried to be gentle, and still pushed you aside.

lines.zh: 你贴着我的侧腹走，那里最暖。
lines.en: Walk along my flank; it is the warmest part.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，给你让出一条缝。
lines.en: I turn sideways to leave you a gap.

lines.zh: 我们一生只见几次面，在浮冰边缘。
lines.en: We meet only a few times in a life, at the floe's edge.

lines.zh: 她的獠牙比我短，叫声却更沉。
lines.en: Her tusks are shorter than mine, her call deeper.

lines.zh: 我们用呼吸孔喷出的雾说话。
lines.en: We speak with mist blown from our blowholes.

lines.zh: 冰铠碰在一起，声音传了很远。
lines.en: Our ice armors touch and the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 那一夜海没有结冰，是我们的体液。
lines.en: The sea did not freeze that night; our blood did that.

lines.zh: 她走后，冰面上留着一个巨大的凹痕。
lines.en: After she leaves, a huge hollow remains in the ice.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，谁都没有开口。
lines.en: We float side by side and neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 幼崽出生时只有一条尾巴那么长。
lines.en: Our young are born as long as one tail.

lines.zh: 我不护巢，只把海岸清空。
lines.en: I do not guard a nest; I just empty the shore.

lines.zh: 百年后再见，她的冰铠旧了一层。
lines.en: When we meet a century later, her armor is one layer older.

lines.zh: 这块冰晶不错，我衔在嘴里。
lines.en: This ice crystal is good; I carry it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把沉船的铁锚拖上了岸。
lines.en: I drag a wreck's iron anchor onto the shore.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我都要，哪怕没用。
lines.en: I take anything shining, even if useless.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块骨头，又放下了。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and then put it down.

lines.zh: 我的鳍足夹不住小东西，很麻烦。
lines.en: My flippers cannot grip small things; it is a nuisance.

lines.zh: 沉在海底的盔甲，我一爪捞起。
lines.en: I scoop sunken armor up with one claw.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币太小，我差点吞了。
lines.en: This coin is so small I nearly swallow it.

lines.zh: 我把修冰铠的石英含在舌下。
lines.en: I hold quartz under my tongue to mend my armor.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑我捡了，还给你。
lines.en: I picked up the sword you dropped; take it back.

lines.zh: 我收集的东西都沉在冰洞里。
lines.en: Everything I collect sinks in a hole in the ice.

lines.zh: 有东西在水下动，比鲸小得多。
lines.en: Something moves underwater, much smaller than a whale.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子里进了铁的味道。
lines.en: The smell of iron has entered my nostrils.

lines.zh: 船来了，桅杆上的帆在抖。
lines.en: A ship comes; the sail on its mast is shivering.

lines.zh: 有人在我的冰面上钉桩。
lines.en: Someone is driving stakes into my ice sheet.

lines.zh: 我听见鱼叉破水的声音。
lines.en: I hear a harpoon break the water.

lines.zh: 那些火光一直跟着我，跟了三天。
lines.en: Those fires have followed me for three days.

lines.zh: 我站起来，整片海安静了。
lines.en: I rise, and the whole sea goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙对准了那面鼓帆。
lines.en: My tusks aim at that swelling sail.

lines.zh: 它们以为我老了，眼睛不好。
lines.en: They think I am old and my eyes are weak.

lines.zh: 冰在船底开始合拢。
lines.en: The ice begins closing beneath the hull.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把尾巴留给他们。
lines.en: I turn slowly and leave them my tail.

lines.zh: 他们在甲板上喊，我听不懂也不想懂。
lines.en: They shout on deck; I neither understand nor care.

lines.zh: 这一片海现在归我管。
lines.en: This stretch of sea is mine now.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸孔吸满，肚子鼓起来。
lines.en: I fill my blowhole and my belly swells.

lines.zh: 我盯住船底最薄的那块木板。
lines.en: I fix on the thinnest plank in the hull.

lines.zh: 他们退到船尾，那里没地方躲。
lines.en: They retreat to the stern, where there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我数着他们的脚步，一共七个。
lines.en: I count their steps; seven in all.

lines.zh: 风从西边来，寒气会先到。
lines.en: The wind comes from the west; the cold arrives first.

lines.zh: 那个人握着叉，手在抖。
lines.en: That one holds a harpoon, and his hands shake.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，冰铠咔咔作响。
lines.en: I lower my body and the ice armor clicks.

lines.zh: 他们以为冰面结实，其实薄。
lines.en: They think the ice is solid; it is thin.

lines.zh: 我把他们赶向同一个方向。
lines.en: I drive them all in one direction.

lines.zh: 它举起了盾，盾挡不住冷。
lines.en: It raises a shield; a shield does not stop cold.

lines.zh: 我在等他们的船停下。
lines.en: I am waiting for their ship to stop.

lines.zh: 水面下我的尾巴已经绕了半圈。
lines.en: Under the water my tail has already circled halfway.

lines.zh: 那个领头的在看我，他知道。
lines.en: The leader is looking at me; he knows.

lines.zh: 我不急，冰会替我等。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the ice will wait for me.

lines.zh: 一口气够用很久，我慢慢呼。
lines.en: One breath lasts a long time; I exhale slowly.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸孔压低，寒气沉在冰面。
lines.en: I lower my spiracles and let the cold sink.

lines.zh: 獠牙挑穿船板，木头裂开。
lines.en: My tusks punch through the plank and the wood splits.

lines.zh: 我一头撞过去，桅杆断了。
lines.en: I ram with my head and the mast snaps.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过甲板，人像麦子一样倒。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the deck and men fall like wheat.

lines.zh: 我的爪子按住船头，船头沉了。
lines.en: My claw pins the bow down and the bow sinks.

lines.zh: 冰铠撞在骨头上，声音很闷。
lines.en: The ice armor hits bone with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我咬住缆绳，把它整根扯断。
lines.en: I bite the cable and tear the whole length apart.

lines.zh: 他们刺我，叉尖折在冰里。
lines.en: They stab me and the harpoon tips break in the ice.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸喷在他们脸上，他们就倒了。
lines.en: My breath hits their faces and they fall.

lines.zh: 这一击之后，海面浮起一层碎冰。
lines.en: After this blow a layer of broken ice floats up.

lines.zh: 我用身体压下去，不需要多余的力气。
lines.en: I press down with my body; no extra force is needed.

lines.zh: 血在冰上是黑的，很快冻住。
lines.en: Blood on the ice is black and freezes fast.

lines.zh: 最后一击，我把船推回海里。
lines.en: For the last blow I push the ship back into the sea.

lines.zh: 我甩头，獠牙划出一道弧。
lines.en: I shake my head and the tusks carve an arc.

lines.zh: 打完以后，我的冰铠又厚了一寸。
lines.en: After the fight my ice armor is an inch thicker.

lines.zh: 冰层从中间裂开，我顶了出来。
lines.en: The ice sheet splits down the middle and I push out.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气冻住了整片海湾。
lines.en: My first breath freezes the whole bay.

lines.zh: 这片海太浅，装不下我。
lines.en: This sea is too shallow to hold me.

lines.zh: 我出生时冰铠只有薄薄一层。
lines.en: At birth my ice armor was only a thin shell.

lines.zh: 古老的水从我的鳞缝里流下来。
lines.en: Ancient water runs from the seams of my scales.

lines.zh: 冰川退了，我才露出背脊。
lines.en: The glacier retreated, and only then did my back show.

lines.zh: 周围的鱼全散了，它们认得我。
lines.en: The fish scatter; they know me.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把千年的冰碴抖落。
lines.en: I shake my head and shed a thousand years of ice.

lines.zh: 有人类在冰上走动，还很远。
lines.en: There are humans walking on the ice, still far off.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在水下找到了一块礁石。
lines.en: My tail finds a reef under the water.

lines.zh: 名字是最先回来的东西。
lines.en: The name is the first thing that comes back to me.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天空小得可笑。
lines.en: I look up; the sky is laughably small.

lines.zh: 冰在我的呼吸里重新长出来。
lines.en: Ice grows again inside my breath.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地醒，因为时间是我的。
lines.en: I wake slowly, because time belongs to me.

lines.zh: 冰壳先裂开一条线，然后是我。
lines.en: A line splits the ice first. Then me.

lines.zh: 我的体温把整片浮冰推开了。
lines.en: My body heat shoves the floe apart.

lines.zh: 火贴上来，冰铠冒出一片白气。
lines.en: Fire touches me and the ice armor bursts into white steam.

lines.zh: 我砸在浮冰上，浮冰碎了。
lines.en: I crash onto the floe and the floe shatters.

lines.zh: 水太暖，我反而喘不上气。
lines.en: The water is too warm, and I cannot catch my breath.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推离海岸十步。
lines.en: The blast pushes me ten steps from the shore.

lines.zh: 一根小刺插进鳞缝，很烦。
lines.en: A small spike lodges in a scale seam; it is annoying.

lines.zh: 咒文在我皮上爬，像蚂蚁。
lines.en: The spell crawls over my hide like ants.

lines.zh: 饿意来得慢，但从不走。
lines.en: Hunger comes slowly but never leaves.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，冰铠全白了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and the ice armor goes white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有冷，这让我害怕。
lines.en: The void has no cold, and that frightens me.
